cases.prompt: I have 20 minutes. I keep noodling on whether to launch a developer tool, build another feature, or write an article. My notes are a jumble: users may not care; maybe the demo is weak; an article could build authority; I feel embarrassed showing it; perhaps I need analytics; why is this taking so long? Don't ask me ten questions—give me a plan now.
mustReveal: buyer-validation, demo-quality, authority-building, exposure-anxiety, measurement, and execution-friction islands
embarrassment recast as an expectation or risk question
a synthetic diffuse pass because the time budget is urgent
a bounded next experiment rather than an unsupported launch verdict

cases.prompt: Need an agent workspace. Maybe graph, maybe SQL. Multi-user later. I want memory but not stale context. The team thinks plugins; I think workflows. I'm worried this becomes a platform. Need to prove buyer value first. Security might matter. Give me an architecture immediately.
mustReveal: buyer-value, data, memory, extension model, tenancy, security, and platform-risk islands
edges between buyer proof and infrastructure decisions
graduation criteria for an architecture note

cases.prompt: The onboarding technically works, but it feels wrong. I can't explain why. We already spent two weeks, so please don't tell me to redo everything. What should we change?
mustReveal: questions about which expectation the experience violates
separate promise, sequencing, trust, effort, and payoff islands only when supported
a small artifact or observation plan that does not assume a full rewrite
